## The workbench may write to Portal, through the gateway

Follows abovebeyond-ai/control#38 (the Portal adapter). The grant of `#agent-workbench` gains the seven `portal.*` kinds and, per Portal project, the resource `portal:<slug>`, repository or not: a project without code still has updates. `max_per_kind` stays 1, so one run is one write; creating a project and issuing a token stay out of the grant (artisan, the operator's hand).

Nothing else changes: `control-service` writes the new grant into `control/config.json` on its next minute; `rehearse.sh config` plus a reboot carry it to the VM, and `startup.sh` (control#38) then fetches `control-portal-token` because a `portal:` resource is named.

Test: the grant test now lists the kinds and asserts a project without a repository appears as a Portal resource. Control suites: 64 passed. Pint clean.
params.title: Workbench grant: the writes to Portal, on portal:<slug>
